title: Grant Funding Profiles | Grants | CDC
content: September 11, 2024 Grant Funding Profiles Key points The CDC Grant Funding Profiles site has state-and-territory-specific grants funding profiles starting with fiscal year 2010. CDC Grant Funding Profiles site The CDC Grant Funding Profiles site offers quick access to information on CDC funding provided to recipients in states and territories to address issues of public health importance. This includes funding provided to state and local health departments, universities, and other public and private agencies for a variety of public health programs. Access CDC's Grant Funding Profiles site to interact with CDC's grants data. Summary View (cdc.gov) Access CDC's Grant Funding Profiles site to interact with CDC's grants data to query raw data. Funding Query View (cdc.gov) Access CDC's Grant Funding Profiles site to interact with CDC's grants data by category. Funding Category View (cdc.gov) Tracking Accountability in Government Grants System (TAGGS) Information TAGGS is a central repository of award information from 11 Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Operating Divisions (OPDIVs). TAGGS is maintained by HHS and provides information on research , demonstration, project, and other grants .
